assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management, consistent with the ordered service
Mobile cardiac telemetry is the specific diagnostic procedure for which SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval
The service was medically necessary to evaluate the patient's documented recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
